definitions.gloss: emergency food distribution; soup kitchen; mass cooking for disaster relief
definitions.explanation: The activity of cooking and distributing food in large quantities, typically to help disaster victims, homeless people, or others in need. A common form of volunteer activity in Japan, especially after natural disasters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We carried out food distribution in the disaster area.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}っている→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: Volunteers are handing out warm meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧、⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}けられた→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: Food distribution by the Self-Defense Forces began the day after the earthquake, delivering meals to people in evacuation shelters.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly associated with disaster relief in Japan. After earthquakes, typhoons, and other natural disasters, {炊|た}き{出|だ}し is one of the first forms of support provided. Also done by community groups and NPOs for homeless people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (carry out food distribution)
- {炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (do food distribution)
- {炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ (participate in food distribution)
- {炊|た}き{出|だ}し⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧ (food distribution volunteer)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {炊|た}き{出|だ}し typically involves cooking large quantities of ⟦{豚汁|とんじる}→豚汁：14229_tonjiru⟧ (pork miso soup), ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧ (rice balls), or ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧ (curry) — foods that can be made in bulk and served easily.
